# Issue 5 : Find the correlation with US Karen data and the other three countries in the future 60 years. (assume only female Karens)

# Package
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```


# Read in Data 
```{r}
data <- read.csv(here("full-names-data-nice.csv"))
```


#Find Corr 
```{r}
data <- data %>% 
  rename_with(tolower)

#US to england/wales '
stat_306 <- help_line_up(data %>% filter(country == "England/Wales" &
                    name == "Karen" &
                    sex == "Girl"), 
            data %>% filter(country == "US" &
                    name == "Karen" &
                    sex == "Girl") )

helperCorLagKaren(
  stat_306 %>% filter(county == "US"),
  60,
  stat_306 %>% filter(country == "England/Wales")
) 

#US with NI 
helperCorLagKaren(
  data %>% filter(country == "US" &
                    Name == "Karen" &
                    Sex == "Girl"),
  60,
  data %>% filter(country == "Northern Ireland" &
                    Name == "Karen" &
                    Sex == "Girl")
) 
# US with Scotland 
helperCorLagKaren(
  data %>% filter(country == "US" &
                    Name == "Karen" &
                    Sex == "Girl"),
  60,
  data %>% filter(country == "Scotland" &
                    Name == "Karen" &
                    Sex == "Girl")
) 
```
